itemdesc-scrapcloth: Scraps of old cloth. “I could probably try to stitch these together.”
itemdesc-patchcloth: Can be used to repair clothes. “We are all patchwork, and so shapeless and diverse in composition that each bit, each moment, plays its own game.”
itemdesc-scrapleather: Scraps of worn leather. “I could probably try to stitch these together.”
itemdesc-patchleather: Probably still useful. “If it works, it works!”
itemdesc-ragtwine: Thin strips cut and twined into recycled cordage. “What do you sew with? ...Everything.”
itemdesc-patchkit: Used for repairs and making some clothes. “What do you sew with? ...Everything.”
item-handbooktext-patchkit: Can be used to repair clothing by 75%. Holding the kit with your mouse pointer, <hk>leftmouse</hk> click on the clothing or armor to be repaired, in your Character inventory.
blockdesc-patchwork-cloth: A makeshift frame covered in patchwork cloth. “If it works, it works!”
blockdesc-patchwork-leather: A makeshift frame covered in patchwork leather. “If it works, it works!”
itemdesc-armor-legs-sewn-patch*: “Much like a patchwork quilt, inspiration that stirs and motivates me is made of many things.”
